workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(filesystem): report a missing parent directory, not a raw chdir error. Target files: src/filesystem/pinned-directory.ts, src/filesystem/__tests__/append-file.test.ts, src/filesystem/__tests__/missing-parent-error.test.ts. A pinned write whose parent directory is missing failed with Node's raw `chdir` error, which named `chdir` (an implementation detail of the pinned-directory anchor) and the **server process's working directory** (wherever the client launched it, possibly outside the allowed directories). `e... (Ref: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5448)

workarounds.symptom: filesystem: edit_file's whitespace-tolerant match fails when oldText ends with a newline
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(filesystem): match edit_file oldText that ends with a newline. Target files: src/filesystem/lib.ts, src/filesystem/__tests__/edit-trailing-newline.test.ts, .changeset/filesystem-5431-edit-trailing-newline.md. `edit_file`'s whitespace-tolerant fallback split `oldText` on `\n`, so a trailing newline became an empty last "line" that had to equal the file's next line. Whole lines copied with their final newline therefore failed to match whenever only indentation differed. (Ref: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5447)

workarounds.symptom: mcp-server-fetch: `fetch` prompt returns JSON-RPC error code 0 with the raw exception text for an invalid URL
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(fetch): reject an invalid prompt URL with -32602. Target files: src/fetch/src/mcp_server_fetch/server.py, src/fetch/tests/test_prompt_url.py, src/fetch/tests/test_protocol.py. The `fetch` prompt passed its `url` argument straight to httpx. A malformed URL such as `http://[::1` raises `httpx.InvalidURL`, which is not an `httpx.HTTPError`, so it escaped `fetch_url`'s handler and the prompt's `except ToolError`, and the SDK answered with its generic fallback for an unhandled exception.
